claim.label: economics
claim.sentence: Palletizing economics Payback is usually argued on injury and turnover as much as on headcount, because manual case stacking carries some of the highest recordable injury rates in a plant.

value.text: Payback is usually argued on injury and turnover as much as on headcount, because manual case stacking carries some of the highest recordable injury rates in a plant.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Plants that only count hourly wages undervalue the cell; the insurance and absence line is often the larger number, though it varies enough by employer that it should not be quoted as a rule.
advance_criteria: Would firm up with published customer injury-rate data before and after installation.
